global.evidence_namespace: Native historical commands record their run under `.ici/rust-v1/` (native evidence namespace, ADR-0008); those files are excluded from the written-file comparison.
global.global_default: Frozen created `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ici/ici.toml` on first use and printed `[ici] 기본 전역 설정을 생성했습니다: <path>`; native never writes the user's configuration directory (legacy-layers-oracle.json records the same difference), so that line and file are excluded.

bare_local_interpreter_plan.reason: Plan JSON is native; the blocked reason of every task using the bare --local-config interpreter is frozen's exact `no project interpreter — no such file: <name>; set ... to change it` text (asserted below).

configless_pyproject_plan.reason: The unparseable pyproject.toml no longer stops planning (frozen exit 0): the announcement lines are equal; the check list is the native catalog's.

diff_without_baseline.reason: Same `diff: baseline <path> cannot be read: ` refusal and exit 2; the trailing OS error text is the Rust io::Error wording.

unparseable_cache.reason: Native `cache` inventories the native observation cache under the workspace (`.ici/rust-v1/observations`, key contract ici.native.observation/v1; config_commands.rs), not frozen's ~/.cache/ici/analysis.
